    Profile

    Freikugel is a "Killer Princess" from the Church of Ragnarok who was guided to this world from the continent of Ragna. She shares her name with her Killium weapon. She has a unique way of speaking and a restless spirit. She has the bad habit of becoming trigger-happy in the heat of battle.

    Origin: Ragna
    Gender: Female
    Height: 156cm
    Weight: 46kg
    Birthday: Jun 3
    Blood Type: Type O
    Zodiac: Gemini
    Likes: The woods
    Hobbies: Bartering
    Illust: moeto
    CV: 釘宮理恵
